# Scores

```{r}
files = list.files(path = 'data/05_evaluated_score/dissected_mouse', full.names = TRUE)
list_of_dfs = lapply(files, FUN = function(x) read.csv(x, row.names = 1))
score_wide = do.call(cbind, list_of_dfs)
```

```{r}
score_wide$metric = rownames(score_wide)
score_wide = score_wide |> 
  filter(!metric %in% c('cell_cycle_conservation', 'isolated_label_F1', 
                       'isolated_label_silhouette', 'kBET', 'hvg_overlap',
                       'trajectory'))
score_long = score_wide |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = 1:19, names_to = 'integration',
               values_to = 'score')
score_long$score = score_long$score |> 
  round(digits = 6)

score_long$integration = score_long$integration |> 
  factor(levels = c(
  # Baselines
  "Unintegrated", "Unintegrated.UINMF",
  # Anchor / MNN-based
  "CCA",       "CCA.UINMF",
  "RPCA",      "RPCA.UINMF",
  "FastMNN",   "FastMNN.UINMF",
  "Scanorama", "Scanorama.UINMF",
  # Embedding / factorization
  "Harmony",   "Harmony.UINMF",
  "LIGER",     "LIGER.UINMF",
  # Graph-based
  "BBKNN",     "BBKNN.UINMF",
  # Deep learning
  "scVI",
  "scANVI",
  # Cross-species
  "SAMap"
))

score_long$uinmf = str_detect(score_long$integration, 'UINMF')

(ggplot(score_long, aes(y = score, x = integration, fill = uinmf)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~metric) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5)) ) |> 
  plotly::ggplotly()
```

```{r}
bio = c('NMI_cluster/label',
        'ARI_cluster/label',
        'ASW_label',
        'ASW_label/batch',
        'graph_conn',
        'cLISI')
batch = score_long$metric[!score_long$metric %in% bio] |> unique()
score_wide['bio_conservation',-20] = score_wide[bio,-20] |> colMeans(na.rm = TRUE)
score_wide['batch_correction', -20] = score_wide[batch, -20] |> colMeans(na.rm = TRUE)
score_wide[c(nrow(score_wide) - 1, nrow(score_wide)), 'metric'] = c('bio_conservation', 'batch_correction')

score_long = score_wide |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = 1:19, names_to = 'integration',
               values_to = 'score')
score_long$score = score_long$score |> 
  round(digits = 6)

score_long$integration = score_long$integration |> 
  factor(levels = c(
    # Baselines
    "Unintegrated", "Unintegrated.UINMF",
    # Anchor / MNN-based
    "CCA",       "CCA.UINMF",
    "RPCA",      "RPCA.UINMF",
    "FastMNN",   "FastMNN.UINMF",
    "Scanorama", "Scanorama.UINMF",
    # Embedding / factorization
    "Harmony",   "Harmony.UINMF",
    "LIGER",     "LIGER.UINMF",
    # Graph-based
    "BBKNN",     "BBKNN.UINMF",
    # Deep learning
    "scVI",
    "scANVI",
    # Cross-species
    "SAMap"
  ))

score_long$uinmf = str_detect(score_long$integration, 'UINMF')

(ggplot(score_long |> filter(metric %in% 
                               c('bio_conservation', 'batch_correction')),
       aes(y = score, x = integration, fill = uinmf)) +
  geom_col() + 
  facet_wrap(~metric) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5))) |> 
  plotly::ggplotly()
```

# SAMap

```{r}
samap_h5ad = read_h5ad('data/04_integrated_data/dissected_mouse/04.02_SAMap.h5ad')
counts_matrix = t(samap_h5ad$X) 



cell_metadata = raw_concat@meta.data

# 4. Create a clean Seurat object
samap_seurat = CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = counts_matrix,
  meta.data = cell_metadata,
  assay = "RNA"
)

# 5. Optional: Bring over your SAMap dimensional reductions (e.g., UMAP, PCA) if they exist
# Look at your reduction names using: names(adata$obsm)
if ("X_umap" %in% names(adata$obsm)) {
  umap_coords <- adata$obsm[["X_umap"]]
  rownames(umap_coords) <- colnames(samap_seurat)
  colnames(umap_coords) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")
  
  samap_seurat[["umap"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
    embeddings = umap_coords, 
    key = "UMAP_", 
    assay = "RNA"
  )
}



samap = samap_h5ad |> as.Seurat()
samap = samap_h5ad$as_Seurat()
samap = readRDS('data/04_integrated_data/dissected_mouse/04.02_SAMap.rds')
DimPlot(samap_h5ad, reduction = 'X_umap', group.by = 'species',
        shuffle = TRUE)
DimPlot(samap_h5ad, reduction = 'X_umap', group.by = 'ds_label',
        shuffle = TRUE)
```

# Seurat CCA

## Ortholog mapping

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| include: false
cca = readRDS('data/04_integrated_data/04.03_CCA.rds')
cca = cca |> 
  ScaleData() |> 
  RunPCA(features = rownames(cca), reduction.name = 'pca_cca') |> 
  RunUMAP(reduction = 'pca_cca',
          dims = 1:20,
          reduction.name = 'umap_cca')
cca[['integrated']]$counts = raw_concat[['Xenium']]$counts
SaveSeuratRds(cca, 'data/04_integrated_data/04.03_CCA.rds')
as.anndata(cca, file_path = 'data/04_integrated_data/', file_name = '04.03_CCA.h5ad', assay = 'integrated', main_layer = 'counts', other_layers = c('data', 'scale.data'))
```

# LIGER UINMF

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| include: false
liger_uinmf = readRDS('data/04_integrated_data/full_mouse/04.11_LIGER_UINMF.rds')
liger_uinmf = liger_uinmf |> 
  ligerToSeurat(assay = 'Xenium')
liger_uinmf@meta.data = raw_concat@meta.data
liger_uinmf = liger_uinmf |> JoinLayers()
as.anndata(liger_uinmf, file_path = 'data/04_integrated_data/', file_name = '04.11_LIGER_UINMF.h5ad', assay = 'Xenium', main_layer = 'counts', other_layers = c('data', 'scale.data'))
DimPlot(liger_uinmf, reduction = 'UMAP', group.by = 'orig.ident',
        shuffle = TRUE)
DimPlot(liger_uinmf, reduction = 'UMAP', group.by = 'ds_label',
        shuffle = TRUE)
raw_concat = add_reduction(raw_concat, 
                           emb = liger_uinmf[['inmf']]@cell.embeddings,
                           loadings = liger_uinmf[['inmf']]@feature.loadings,
                           key = 'inmf_', name = 'inmf', assay = 'Xenium')
raw_concat = add_reduction(raw_concat,
                           emb = liger_uinmf[['UMAP']]@cell.embeddings,
                           loadings = liger_uinmf[['UMAP']]@feature.loadings,
                           key = 'umap_', name = 'umap', assay = 'Xenium')
as.anndata(raw_concat, file_path = 'data/04_integrated_data/', file_name = '04.11_LIGER_UINMF.h5ad', assay = 'Xenium', main_layer = 'counts', other_layers = c('data', 'scale.data'))
```
